Text.Text: I'm Captain Jorn Hale, and I run the guard on the Anchorhead caravans. If you want passage, ask the dockhands. If you want a fight, I have a list of them.
Here is your pay. He will replace those fighters inside a month unless we give him a reason not to. Ask me about his war banners when you are ready.
You are back, and a caravan came in yesterday without being stopped. Did you kill all ten Tusken Elites?

The Tuskens now stop each caravan, take one bantha in five and let it go. That is a toll, and it means a warlord is in charge, holed up in the Tusken Raider Cave with his best fighters. I need you to go into the cave and kill ten Tusken Elites. Come back to me here at the spaceport and I will pay you.
Good. Kill ten Tusken Elites in the Tusken Raider Cave, not the ordinary raiders out in the dunes, then come back to me here at the Anchorhead Spaceport.
Some of the caravan masters did pay. Then the toll went up to one bantha in four. A toll like that only ever goes up.
It is out past the Tusken Camp. You will know the Elites inside, because they are better wrapped and better armed, and they do not run.
I still need ten Tusken Elites killed in the Tusken Raider Cave. The ordinary raiders outside do not count. Come back to me when all ten are dead.
Here is your pay. Two of the smaller clans left the cave overnight, so he has only his own people now. Ask me about the warlord himself when you are ready.
That makes five banners, and I will hang them over the caravan gate before sundown. Are you ready for your pay?

When the warlord's people collect the toll, they carry a strip of hide with his mark on it, and the other clans watch who carries it. I need you to take five Tusken War Banners from the Tusken Elites in the Tusken Raider Cave and bring them to me here. I will hang them at the port for every clan to see.
Good. Take five Tusken War Banners from the Tusken Elites in the Tusken Raider Cave and bring them to me here at the spaceport. Not every Elite carries one.
It will matter to the clans who follow him. He is only a warlord while they do, and they will not follow a mark that can be taken.
I still need five Tusken War Banners. The Tusken Elites in the Tusken Raider Cave carry them, though not every one does. Bring all five to me here.
Next we take his war banners, but first finish the job you have. Kill the ten Tusken Elites in the Tusken Raider Cave, then come and see me.
Then every caravan keeps all its banthas. Here is the masters' purse, and this Caravan Master's Sash is from them too. Each of them wears one, and now so do you.
You are back. The cave has been silent for two days and my scouts will not go close. Is the Tusken Warlord dead?

It is time. The warlord has not come up from the bottom floor of the Tusken Raider Cave since his banners went over my gate. I need you to go down there and kill the Tusken Warlord. Come back to me here when he is dead. The caravan masters have put together a large purse for it.
Good. Kill the Tusken Warlord on the bottom floor of the Tusken Raider Cave, then come back to me here at the Anchorhead Spaceport. I want to tell the masters myself.
They will go back to ordinary raiding. I can live with that, because raiding is something my guards know how to defend against.
Do not go alone, and clear the floors above him first. Any Elites you leave behind will come down the tunnel at the worst moment.
I still need the Tusken Warlord killed. He is on the bottom floor of the Tusken Raider Cave. Clear the floors above him first, then come back to me.
After that we go for the warlord himself, but first finish the job you have. Bring me the five Tusken War Banners.
He killed four of my guards, and now I can tell their families it is settled. The bounty is yours.
You are back. My scout found a gaderffii stuck upright in the sand outside the cave, which is how they mark their dead. Is Urrok dead?

The warlord has three champions, and Urrok is his best with the gaderffii. He killed four of my guards in one fight, on foot, against blasters. I need you to find Urrok, Gaderffii Champion, in the Tusken Raider Cave and kill him. Come back to me here afterward and I will gladly pay the bounty.
Good. Kill Urrok, Gaderffii Champion, in the Tusken Raider Cave, then come back to me here at the spaceport. Do not let him get close to you.
He stays in the Tusken Raider Cave among the Elites, but he is not always there because he goes out with the war parties. Keep going back until you find him.
I still need Urrok, Gaderffii Champion, killed. He is in the Tusken Raider Cave, though not every day. Come back to me when he is dead.
Then my drivers can sit up straight again. Here is the bounty, and thank you.
You are back. Three caravans have come in with every lead bantha still walking. Is Sharrak Long-Eye dead?

Sharrak Long-Eye is the warlord's sniper. Sharrak shoots the lead bantha, the caravan stops, and the toll collectors walk in. My drivers ride with their heads down because of it. I need you to find Sharrak Long-Eye in the Tusken Raider Cave and kill the sniper. Come back to me here and I will pay the bounty.
Good. Kill Sharrak Long-Eye in the Tusken Raider Cave, then come back to me here at the spaceport. Close the distance as fast as you can.
Sharrak rests in the Tusken Raider Cave between raids, but is not always there. When you find the sniper, get close fast, because at range you have already lost.
I still need Sharrak Long-Eye killed. The sniper is in the Tusken Raider Cave, though not every day. Get close quickly, and come back to me when it is done.
Then they have lost their voice. Here is the bounty, and it was well earned.
You are back. The last war party that attacked us broke when we shot back, which has never happened before. Is Warcaller Aa'rkha dead?

Warcaller Aa'rkha does not fight much, but when the Warcaller shouts, every Tusken in earshot fights like two. The warlord gives the orders, and Aa'rkha is the reason they are obeyed. I need you to find Warcaller Aa'rkha in the Tusken Raider Cave and kill the Warcaller. Come back to me here and I will pay the bounty.
Good. Kill Warcaller Aa'rkha in the Tusken Raider Cave, then come back to me here at the spaceport. Make the Warcaller your first target, not your last.
In the Tusken Raider Cave, like the others, but the Warcaller comes and goes. If Aa'rkha is there, kill the Warcaller first, before the rest get brave.
I still need Warcaller Aa'rkha killed. The Warcaller is in the Tusken Raider Cave, though not every day. Come back to me when it is done.
Goodbye, Captain. Safe crossing.
What other work is on your list?
Yes, ten of his Elites are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. Ten Tusken Elites in the cave.
Not right now. The Tuskens can keep their cave.
Why not just pay the toll?
Where is the Tusken Raider Cave?
Are the Tuskens giving your caravans trouble?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Tusken Elites.
Yes. Hang them high, Captain.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you five Tusken War Banners.
Not right now. I'm done with that cave.
Will losing his banners matter to him?
What do you want done about the warlord's banners?
Here are the five Tusken War Banners.
I'm still taking them. I'll come back.
Remind me what you need with the war banners.
What comes after thinning the warlord's guard?
Yes, the Tusken Warlord is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll end the toll. I'll kill the Tusken Warlord.
Not right now. That's a job for an army.
What happens to the clans afterward?
Is there anything I should know first?
Is it time to deal with the warlord himself?
Still working on it.
Remind me where to find the Tusken Warlord.
What comes after the war banners?
Yes, Urrok is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the bounty. I'll kill Urrok.
Not right now. I'll pass on this one.
How do I find Urrok?
Is there a bounty on the warlord's champion, Urrok?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the bounty on Urrok.
Yes, Sharrak Long-Eye is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the bounty. I'll kill Sharrak Long-Eye.
Not right now. I won't hunt a sniper.
Where will I find Sharrak?
Is there a bounty on the warlord's sniper?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the bounty on Sharrak Long-Eye.
Yes, Warcaller Aa'rkha is dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the bounty. I'll kill Warcaller Aa'rkha.
Not right now. I'll leave that one.
Where will I find the Warcaller?
Is there a bounty on whoever rallies the clans?
Still working on it.
Remind me about the bounty on Warcaller Aa'rkha.
